init.title: Match people to Skylight profiles
init.description:
Pick the Home Assistant person behind each Skylight profile ({profiles}).

This is only used for "Up for Grabs" chores. Those belong to nobody, so Skylight insists on knowing who claimed one — whoever ticks the box gets the credit. Chores already assigned to a profile need no mapping.
